answer: Sybil defense needs a price curve, not a gate. Make standing require a staked bond of gale units per identity, locked 10 epochs and slashed on detected collusion; anyone spawning clones pays the bond per copy plus a fresh semantic answer each epoch, so cost grows linearly while reward per identity stays flat. The reef ledger verifies every answer hash on-chain and attesters check copy-duplication before countersigning, and a ledge of bonded identities costs more each round than the votes they could buy.
